description.narrative: This project strengthens member countries' ability to counter violent extremism. It will achieve this by providing technical assistance to identified member countries with a view to a) incrementally strengthening good governance and the rule of law in the policies and practices applied to the management of terrorism; b) build the capability and the relationships required to prevent or manage violent extremism, including a systematic CVE policy and measures that activate one or more of the mechanisms to prevent and counter violent extremism; c) systematic pro-social steps to rehabilitate and reintegrate individuals that radicalised and/or joined violent extremist groups.
